name: pivot-report
description: Turn a detail table into a summary report the way an Excel pivot table does — group by store, category, salesperson or anything else, spread months or quarters across the top, and sum, count or average a value — without fiddling with Excel's pivot menus. Percentages, top N and a bar chart included; export a clean Excel report, CSV or a printable HTML page. Runs locally; no API keys.

description_i18n.en: Turn a detail table into a summary report the way an Excel pivot table does — group by store, category, salesperson or anything else, spread months or quarters across the top, and sum, count or average a value — without fiddling with Excel's pivot menus. Percentages, top N and a bar chart included; export a clean Excel report, CSV or a printable HTML page. Runs locally; no API keys.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 像 Excel 数据透视表一样把明细表变成汇总报表——按门店、品类、销售员或任意字段分组，把月份或季度横向展开，对数值求和、计数或求平均——不用再折腾 Excel 的透视表菜单。支持百分比、前 N 名和条形图；可导出整洁的 Excel 报表、CSV 或可打印的 HTML 页面。在本地运行，无需 API 密钥。
